summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine PDMR share transaction by Group Finance Director Anna Cross, involving the disposal of 461,588 ordinary shares at 5.211 GBP per share via the company's nominee service. This is a standard disclosure of managerial share dealings, not a special-situation event. The filing contains no strategic corporate action, no offer, and no recommendation. It is an informational notice to the London Stock Exchange furnished to the SEC. No special-situation category applies; this is a routine regulatory filing.
